📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-10-09
1. ChatGPT's "Intelligent UI" update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons產品
ChatGPT「智慧介面」更新：回答可含圖片、圖表與按鈕
OpenAI is rolling out Intelligent UI to all users alongside GPT-6, letting ChatGPT combine text with diagrams, charts, forms and tappable buttons.
OpenAI 隨 GPT-6 向所有使用者推出智慧介面，讓 ChatGPT 能在文字回覆中結合圖表、表單與可點選按鈕。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1007276/openai-chatgpt-intelligent-ui-gpt-6
2. Google launches a universal Gemini agent for work tasks產品
Google 推出一站式 Gemini 工作代理
The agent works across apps in the background, can delegate to subagents and use multiple models, and even gets its own workplace identity and email address.
此代理可在背景跨應用程式作業、委派子代理並使用多種模型，甚至擁有自己的職場身分與電子郵件地址。
The Verge / TechCrunch · https://www.theverge.com/tech/1007904/google-gemini-ai-agent-enterprise
3. Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects資安
Anthropic 推出開源專案免費 AI 資安掃描
The new OSS Scanner gives opt-in open-source projects periodic security scans by Anthropic's strongest models at no cost.
新服務 OSS Scanner 讓選擇加入的開源專案，免費獲得由 Anthropic 最強模型進行的定期資安掃描。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1008521/anthropic-open-source-oss-scanner
4. Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference政策
Anthropic 修改使用政策，禁止濫用模型與干預選舉
The updated policy prohibits sustained abuse of Claude in extreme cases, while still allowing ordinary criticism. It also covers election interference, weapons software and surveillance.
新政策明確禁止極端情況下持續濫用 Claude，但仍允許一般批評；同時規範選舉干預、武器軟體與監控。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/anthropic-changes-usage-policy-to-ban-model-abuse-and-election-interference/
5. OpenAI's revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected產業
傳 OpenAI 營收比先前預估少 200 億美元
Earlier reports put the lab's annualized revenue at about $70 billion, but a new report claims it is far lower.
先前報導 OpenAI 年化營收約 700 億美元，但最新報導指出實際數字低得多。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/openais-revenue-is-reportedly-20-billion-less-than-previously-projected/
6. USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI政策
USA Today 成為最新控告 OpenAI 的出版商
USA Today Co. and its local papers allege OpenAI copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its models, seeking more than $250 million in damages.
USA Today 集團及旗下地方報紙指控 OpenAI 複製「數十萬篇」文章訓練模型，求償逾 2.5 億美元。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1008198/usa-today-openai-copyright-lawsuit
7. Three ccTLDs hijacked, attackers obtained HTTPS certificates for Google and other domains資安
3 個國碼頂級網域遭劫持，攻擊者取得 Google 等組織 HTTPS 憑證
Google disclosed that attackers compromised the .gh, .sl and .as ccTLDs, altered authoritative DNS records and obtained unauthorized certificates. Google says its own systems were not breached.
Google 揭露攻擊者入侵 .gh、.sl、.as 三個國碼網域，竄改權威 DNS 紀錄並取得未經授權的憑證；Google 表示自家系統未遭入侵。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179500
8. Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect產業
遭解僱的 OpenAI 安全研究員否認不當行為指控，警告恐造成寒蟬效應
Three fired researchers deny mishandling sensitive information and say in an open letter that the dismissals chill the company's AI safety culture.
三位遭解僱的研究員否認洩漏敏感資訊，並在公開信中表示此舉將對公司的 AI 安全文化造成寒蟬效應。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/fired-openai-safety-researchers-dispute-misconduct-claims-warn-of-chilling-effect/
9. Goodfire says its "inside-out" monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost研究
Goodfire 稱「由內而外」監控能以低成本抓出失控 AI 代理
Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, the monitors peek inside the model as it works and call for backup only when something looks suspicious.
不必再付費請第二個 AI 閱讀代理的一切行為，監控器會在模型運作時窺探其內部，僅在可疑時才請求支援。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/goodfire-says-its-new-inside-out-monitors-catch-rogue-ai-agents-at-a-fraction-of-the-cost/
10. China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta產業
中國 Manus 與 Meta 分道揚鑣後首輪募資逾 5 億美元
Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led the round, with existing shareholders including Tencent, HSG and ZhenFund also participating.
本輪由博裕資本與 IDG 資本領投，既有股東騰訊、HSG（前紅杉中國）、真格基金等亦參與。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/chinas-manus-raises-over-500m-in-first-funding-round-since-split-with-meta/
